name: asciidoclint
description: AsciiDoc syntax, structure, and document-policy linter
author: Shawn Hu

scripts.build:extension: npm run build && npm run build -w ./packages/vscode-asciidoclint
scripts.test: vitest run src/api/*.test.ts src/cli/*.test.ts src/formatters/*.test.ts src/rules/*.test.ts
scripts.check: npm run version:check && npm run build && npm test && npm run test:coverage && npm run build:extension && npm run test:extension
scripts.release:npm:dry-run: npm run version:check && npm run build && npm pack --dry-run
scripts.release:npm:publish: npm run version:check && npm run build && npm publish --access public
scripts.release:npm:publish:provenance: npm run version:check && npm run build && npm publish --access public --provenance
scripts.release:vscode:package: npm run version:check && npm run build:extension && npm run package -w ./packages/vscode-asciidoclint
scripts.release:vscode:publish: npm run version:check && npm run build:extension && npm run publish:marketplace -w ./packages/vscode-asciidoclint
scripts.release:open-vsx:publish: npm run release:vscode:package && npm run publish:open-vsx -w ./packages/vscode-asciidoclint
